scope: SfM-only bounded CV-HR leaf03 repair preflight; no 3DGS/SOGS work claimed or launched.

failure_summary.terminal_log_fact: Chunk 3 registered 341/360 total images (94.72%) but 261/280 core images (93.21%); skipping boundary recovery

root_cause: The leaf acceptance contract allowed a relaxed core-only pass to skip boundary recovery even when total registration was far below the strict CV-HR production gate, leaving no chance to recover the missing boundary/overlap images.

patch.summary: Core-only leaf acceptance is now opt-in via COLMAP_CHUNK_ALLOW_CORE_ONLY_PASS=1. The default production path keeps attempting boundary recovery whenever total registration is below COLMAP_GPS_MIN_REGISTERED_RATIO, even if relaxed core registration is above COLMAP_CHUNK_MIN_CORE_REGISTERED_RATIO.
patch.metadata_added: sfm_metadata.chunk_allow_core_only_pass records whether the legacy opt-in path was enabled.
